_comment: Single source of the company facts shown on the site. scripts/sync.mjs writes every value into the elements that carry data-fact="<key>". An empty value fails `npm run build`, so the image cannot be built while a fact is missing. Never guess a registration number.
name: Data Concept Studio
legalForm: Sole proprietorship (jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza) entered in CEIDG, the Polish register of sole traders
legalFormPl: Jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza wpisana do CEIDG
